name: Hosted Agents — static gateway
summary: Invocation of a pre-deployed Hosted Agent (container-backed) whose orchestrator model is BYOM-routed.
description: Hosted Agents are deployed out-of-band via `azd ai agent init` + container image. This test looks up an existing hosted agent by name and invokes it through the Responses API. BYOM at the manifest level is unconfirmed; the container code can BYOM-route its own Responses calls.
notes: Skips with ::warning:: if HOSTED_AGENT_NAME_STATIC is unset. Deployment of the hosted agent itself is outside the scope of this matrix.
